# Season Shelf 1.2.3

This update fixes automatic series watches and cleans up unfinished download data more reliably.

- Series watches advance past scanned posts even when they contain no matching video, preventing repeat scans and stalled watches.
- Clearing app data removes unfinished download data and unused partial files while keeping completed media and account preferences.
- Failed publication cleans up its temporary destination copy when the selected drive remains safe to access.
- Download progress writes and full UI updates occur less often, reducing disk and renderer work during large queues.

Windows installations can update from within the app. On macOS, download the universal DMG and replace the app in Applications. The builds remain unsigned and the macOS build is not notarized.
